# Pumni Web OS — Copilot Guide

Use `AGENTS.md` as the shared repository guide.
For surfaces that do not load `AGENTS.md`, apply its security mandates and validation commands directly.
For Next.js app code, read `apps/web/AGENTS.md` and `docs/conventions/nextjs-16.md`.
Run narrowest validation gate before reporting done (`bun run ai:check` for context edits, `bun run ai:review` for policy/security).
